title: Hackers breach US Air Force Cloud One computing platform
summary: Reuters reported on 27 November that hackers breached Cloud One, the US Air Force's flagship cloud computing platform, in an intrusion that could jeopardise sensitive tactical, personnel and logistics data. NBC News reported that a US official confirmed the hack. The attackers, the full scope of the intrusion and whether data was stolen have not been established. It follows a reported breach of the FBI's National Crime Information Center.
impact_assessment: Observed: disruption across the Cloud One platform after the intrusion was discovered. Potential: exposure of sensitive military data used by Air Force applications, and a pattern of intrusions into US federal systems.
priority_rationale: HIGH: a reported compromise of a core US military cloud platform with possible exposure of sensitive data; attribution and scope unknown.

reported_claims.text: The intrusion at Cloud One was discovered within the past month or so during work to upgrade the system and has led to disruption across the platform; the breach could jeopardise a vast swath of sensitive tactical, personnel and logistics data.
reported_claims.attributed_to: Reuters, citing two people familiar with the matter (as relayed by NBC News/WRAL)

reported_claims.text: A US official confirmed the hack without giving details or saying when the attack occurred.
The Department of the Air Force said it does not comment on the security posture, vulnerabilities or operational status of specific networks and systems.
The FBI's National Crime Information Center was also recently breached; it is unclear whether the breaches are related.
reported_claims.attributed_to: NBC News, citing sources briefed on the matter

unknowns: Full scope of the intrusion and when it began
Whether it is linked to other recent federal breaches
reassessment_triggers: Official attribution to a state actor
Disclosure of further federal breaches linked to the same actor
monitoring_actions: Watch for Air Force, Pentagon or CISA statements

sources.title: Air Force's cloud computing platform hacked in latest cyberattack on federal assets
